head: thang
rule: ทาง's ten senses fan out from one road, and the road keeps most of them. Sense 1 takes anything you could physically travel — the highway, the shortcut, the dead end, the distance along it, the acts of clearing, leading, yielding and setting out — and it keeps ทางช้างเผือก, because the Milky Way is named as a road across the sky and not as a method. The abstractions divide by what they answer: sense 2 (ช่อง) is a designated channel and takes ช่องทาง; sense 3 (โอกาส) is a prospect and takes ลู่ทาง; sense 4 (แนว) is a line or bearing and takes ทิศทาง, ท่าทาง and พันทาง, the crossed strain; sense 5 (วิธีการ) is a course of action and takes ทางการ, ทางเลือก, เข้าทาง. Sense 8 is one teacher's musical manner and takes ทางเก็บ. Sense 6 (แถว, แถบ, ถิ่น), the locality, stays empty — nothing in this list names a region.

1: ทางช้างเผือก
